SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN dateDiff('day', last_order_date, today()) <= 90 THEN 'Active'
    WHEN dateDiff('day', last_order_date, today()) <= 180 THEN 'At Risk'
    ELSE 'Churned'
  END AS CustomerSegment,
  count() AS CustomerCount
FROM
(
  SELECT CustomerKey, max(DateKey) AS last_order_date
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY CustomerSegment
ORDER BY CustomerSegment
